Method of Attack: Hijacking VPN connections by injecting arbitrary data payloads into IPv4 and IPv6 TCP streams
Determining VPN client’s virtual IP address
Using encrypted replies to unsolicited packets to determine sequence and acknowledgment numbers
Injecting data into the TCP stream to hijack connections
Discoverer: Breakpointing Bad researchers at University of New Mexico
Impacted Systems: Unix-like operating systems including FreeBSD, OpenBSD, macOS, iOS, Android
Linux distros using systemd versions released after November 28, 2018 with Reverse Path filtering switched from Strict to Loose mode
Attack Vector: Network adjacent attacker exploiting VPN connection vulnerabilities
Exploiting default systemd configurations with loose rp_filter settings
Exploiting encrypted packet size and timing information
